title: Late-Booking Interest Days on a Closing and Funding Late-Funding Refund
content:
In the Closing and Funding product, the refund deadline of a late-funding refund is the last of the closing method's per diem refund business days (10 under every closing method), counted Monday through Friday starting with the day after the disbursement date, and a refund is booked late when its booking date falls after that deadline.

**Rule.** The late-booking interest days of a late-funding refund are counted as follows: where the refund is booked more than 30 calendar days after the refund deadline, they run from the date the charge collected at closing was booked through the booking date, both counted; where the refund is booked late but no more than 30 calendar days after the refund deadline, they run from the day after the refund deadline through the booking date, both counted; otherwise there are no late-booking interest days.

The charge collected at closing is the closing's prepaid interest charge booked on the signing date; its booking date is the date recorded on that charge entry.

| Booking date relative to the refund deadline | Late-booking interest days |
|---|---|
| on or before the deadline | none |
| 1 to 30 calendar days after the deadline | from the day after the deadline through the booking date, both counted |
| more than 30 calendar days after the deadline | from the booking date of the charge collected at closing through the booking date, both counted |

## Example (hypothetical dates: charge booked 29 May, refund deadline 17 June)

| Refund booked on | Calendar days after the deadline | Interest days |
|---|---|---|
| 17 June | 0 | none |
| 30 June | 13 | 18 June through 30 June: 13 |
| 17 July | 30 | 18 June through 17 July: 30 |
| 18 July | 31 | 29 May through 18 July: 51 |
